fnol_text: My name is Tariq Iyer and I live at 70 Thornbury Court, Clinton, NC 28318. You can reach me on (555) 334-5287 or tariq.iyer@example.com. On 4 April 2025 I tried to drive through a flooded road under the bridge. The water was deeper than I thought and the engine cut out and filled with water. Policy MT-2024-00078. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Iyer on (555) 334-5287 to acknowledge the claim. Tariq confirmed the loss date as 4 April 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Ingrid Thorne gave a statement by phone.
Tariq sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
